blocks.x: Blockchain & Digital Trust for Public Safety & Justice — dlt networks, tokenization and verifiable credentials — shared truth with regulatory teeth applied to the public safety & justice operating unit of Public Sector & Government.

Police, fire, EMS and courts coordinate under minutes-matter constraints and the strictest accountability: evidence integrity, proportionality and privacy. Achala IT Solutions engineers the intelligence layer with auditability as a design primitive, not a feature.

items: Dispatch, records and evidence systems siloed; coordination manual.

blocks.x: The pattern composes Decentralized Identity & Verifiable Credentials, Asset Tokenization & Digital Assets, Blockchain Analytics & Regulatory Compliance from the Blockchain & Digital Trust tower, wired into the unit's workflows (Dispatch and coordination, Evidence management, Report generation) on Patient Priority Portal and Tele Medicine Platform. Governance inherits the sector frame — Criminal-procedure rules among others — with evidence generated by the delivery itself.

items: On-chain transparency, operationalized — analytics, Travel Rule and MiCA-aligned controls.
Permissioned networks for multi-party truth — governance, consensus and integration done institutionally.
Instruments as tokens — issuance, custody and lifecycle under securities-law discipline.
custody events anchored with access logs (integrity cryptographic)
